goal: Review Ruby and Rails-style code for injection, mass assignment, dynamic code, callbacks and tests.
use: Review Ruby and Rails-style code for injection, mass assignment, dynamic code, callbacks and tests. Use when asked to review or harden a Ruby project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Open the Gemfile, the lock file, the Ruby version and any Rails configuration.
Check injection. Flag SQL built with string interpolation, and user input passed to system, backticks or eval.
Check mass assignment. Flag models that accept every parameter.
Check dynamic code. Flag send, instance_eval and constantize on user input.
Check callbacks. Flag callbacks that call external services, which make saves slow and hard to test.
Report. List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix.
